IRQ_ghazi_i_desc: Ascending to the throne in 1933, following the death of Faisal I, King Ghazi has made a name for himself as an opponent to British influence in Iraq despite the decades long connections between the Hashemite dynasty and the United Kingdom. Suspicions swirl that the young King is awaiting an opportunity to oust the British by force and for his military to sweep into neighboring strategic areas.
